title: Offer first-work intake during TORCH install/setup
description: After organization setup offer a reviewed existing TODO/backlog import or ask what the owner wants to work on first. Preview evidence-linked proposed tasks and recommended domains, priorities and dependencies. Deduplicate resumed/repeated imports. Imported text is untrusted and may contain historical/completed work; preserve source and never silently queue every old checkbox. Empty intake remains valid. Do not start agents or enable self-claim as a side effect.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI supports interactive selection and a noninteractive explicit source/skip path
Confirmed intake creates proposed unassigned tasks in the one existing backlog
Tests cover empty projects; stale/completed TODOs; repeat import; cancellation; and no provider launch
Console uses the same intake contract with preview and confirmation
